recommendation: Force local resolution in sovereign-ui by moving all CSS/PostCSS dependencies to the local folder and using a dedicated vite.config.ts that disables root searching.
alternatives: Rename the root postcss.config.js temporarily or use a different config file name for the standalone project using the --config flag in Vite/PostCSS.
Remove the '@tailwindcss/vite' plugin and rely purely on `@tailwindcss/postcss` with a hardcoded path to the local node_modules in postcss.config.js.
